leo (partnerships): Quick heads-up: Hyperspan confirmed EAP access for their SPN-Delta board next Tue. NDA countersigned by Adele. They asked for a compact bench runbook + artifact handoff process.
sara (eng-infra): great. do we have the image + exact kernel they want installed? also need to know if they prefer ssh or sftp for artifacts.
leo (partnerships): Hyperspan sent an image tar (sha256: a1b2...) and a kernel build tag. They prefer S3 presigned uploads but said they can accept an SFTP fallback.
carmen (solutions): recommend we standardize on: smoke -> latency p50/95 (seq256) -> throughput sweep (batch 1..16) -> end-to-end sample set (10 inferences) -> quick eval for quality. Keep each step <12 min.
ben (ml): for quality, i'll run 30 compliance prompts + 20 functional prompts. output CSV with seed + deterministic sampling. also will run `evaluate.perplexity()` for a quick signal.
leo (partnerships): legal: embargo on publication until joint marketing ok. Hyperspan wants preliminary notes within 48h of the window. Adele?
adele (legal): confirmed. embargo until both parties sign a joint release. we can provide a one-line neutral status update to partners only. no public numbers.
sara (eng-infra): ops note: cross-account presigned S3 requires INF-6799 provisioning; create ticket ASAP. if they want SFTP we'll need host allowlist. deploy-bot can provision temporary creds.
deploy-bot: INF-6799 created by sara at 1734500105. ETA: 20h. Temp SFTP user request: REQ-2075 queued.
carmen (solutions): can we include a decision table for quantization? propose: prefer int8-q8_0 for peak perf, fallback fp16 if quality drops > 3% BLEU-like metric. add to runbook.
ben (ml): agree. i'll include a tiny script that checks mean token logprob delta and flags regression.
sara (eng-infra): telemetry: capture p50/p95 token latency, peak GPU mem, host CPU % for window. keep detailed per-layer traces off by default. we can enable on request.
leo (partnerships): Hyperspan also asked about marketplace readiness: they want a short stub we can include in the cloud marketplace listing (non-numeric). we need legal clearance before giving anything public.
adele (legal): marketplace blurb must be pre-approved. i'll draft one neutral line and circulate to marketing + Hyperspan.
carmen (solutions): scheduling: propose Tue 09:00-11:30 PT for bench window. lab ops available morning. can we lock that?
sara (eng-infra): tentative OK. need INF-6799 to finish before we can share presigned URLs. if not, we'll use SFTP.
leo (partnerships): ok i'll RSVP the time to Hyperspan and mark as tentative internally. deliverables: 1) 1-page runbook PDF, 2) bench scripts (bash + small python parser), 3) tiny eval harness, 4) upload process doc (S3 + SFTP), 5) internal summary deck (1 slide).
carmen (solutions): i'll draft the runbook checklist. short commands only, e.g.:
```
# smoke test
./run_bench.sh --image spn-delta.tar --smoke
```
ben (ml): i'll add `eval_harness.py --seed 42 --prompts prompts.csv --out results.csv`. keep hyperparams pinned.
sara (eng-infra): i'll create repo infra/bench/hyperspan-eap and push WIP. PR number will be referenced in runbook.
leo (partnerships): can someone draft the two-line neutral status we can give Hyperspan now (for internal comms)? something non-committal.
carmen (solutions): draft: "Initial internal validation runs scheduled with Hyperspan hardware; results under embargo pending joint review."
adele (legal): +1, ok to send to Hyperspan as a status line.
leo (partnerships): perfect. one more ask from Hyperspan: SI partner wants a single Slack thread with bench artifacts for their integrator. we should decide if we create a dedicated channel or share a limited thread. thoughts?
sara (eng-infra): prefer sharing S3 + minimal thread. no channel access. create a short thread and attach the runbook + presigned link after INF-6799 is ready.
carmen (solutions): agree. we'll keep comms minimal and attach pointer to the internal summary only.
ben (ml): timeline recap: scripts + runbook by EOD today, INF-6799 pending, bench Tue morning, internal slide deck Wed morning.
sara (eng-infra): ack. i'll post PR link when ready.
leo (partnerships): thanks everyone. i'll notify Hyperspan with the neutral line and the tentative schedule. will update here after INF-6799 completes. :white_check_mark:
